neighbourhood.name: Don Valley Village
neighbourhood.summary: The character of Don Valley Village is exemplified by its slower-paced atmosphere. This neighbourhood features a good amount of greenery as many tree-lined streets are present. There are over 50 green spaces close by for residents to explore, including East Don Parkland and Parkway Forest Park, and they are very well-spread out, making it very easy to access them from most locations within this area. This area is quiet overall, as there tend to be low levels of noise from traffic - although there are still several louder sections, especially closer to Highway 404 Collector or Highway 404.
